content.short: Push Protocol provides notifications and a peer-to-peer messaging protocol for Web3 dApps.
content.description: Push Protocol is a Web3 communication network that enables cross-chain notifications and messaging for dapps, wallets, and services. It powers communications for over 100 leading dapps and service providers across DeFi, NFTs, gaming, and dev tools, delivering timely updates and alerts to users across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Solana, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Base, and other supported chains. By offering a shared messaging layer, it helps projects reach audiences as they interact across multiple ecosystems.
content.meta: Push Protocol is a Web3 messaging and notification network for dapps wallets and services. Discover Push Protocol and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
